title: Asymptotically perfect seeded graph matching without edge correlation (and applications to inference)
abstract: arXiv:2506.02825v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We present the OmniMatch algorithm for seeded multiple graph matching. In the setting of $d$-dimensional Random Dot Product Graphs (RDPG), we prove that under mild assumptions, OmniMatch with $s$ seeds asymptotically and efficiently perfectly aligns $O(s^{\alpha})$ unseeded vertices -- for $\alpha<2\wedge d/4$ -- across multiple networks even in the presence of no edge correlation. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our algorithm across numerous simulations and in the context of shuffled graph hypothesis testing. In the shuffled testing setting, testing power is lost due to the misalignment/shuffling of vertices across graphs, and we demonstrate the capacity of OmniMatch to correct for misaligned vertices prior to testing and hence recover the lost testing power. We further demonstrate the algorithm on a pair of data examples from connectomics and machine translation.

translated_title: 渐近完美的种子图匹配无需边相关性（及其在推断中的应用）
translated_abstract: arXiv:2506.02825v3 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：我们提出了用于种子多图匹配的OmniMatch算法。在$d$维随机点积图（RDPG）的设置中，我们证明在温和假设下，带有$s$个种子的OmniMatch算法能够渐近且高效地完美对齐$O(s^{\alpha})$个未种子顶点——其中$\alpha<2\wedge d/4$——即使在无边相关性的情况下也能跨多个网络实现。我们通过大量模拟以及在乱序图假设检验的背景下证明了我们算法的有效性。在乱序检验设置中，由于跨图顶点错位/乱序导致检验功效损失，我们展示了OmniMatch在检验前纠正错位顶点并因此恢复损失检验功效的能力。我们还在来自连接组学和机器翻译的两个数据示例上进一步演示了该算法。
tldr: 提出了OmniMatch算法，在无边缘相关性的随机点积图中利用种子实现渐近完美对齐多个网络，并能恢复乱序图假设检验中因错位损失的功效。
en_tdlr: OmniMatch algorithm achieves asymptotically perfect alignment of multiple networks using seeds in random dot product graphs without edge correlation, recovering lost testing power in shuffled graph hypothesis testing.
